ops.title: Dev builds cannot evict the running release daemon (daemonkit trust)
ops.body: Since the daemonkit trust-verifier hard cut (cc-review v0.31.x), a locally built `go build` binary fails to evict a running release daemon with `wire: prepare stop connect: wire: untrusted peer`. Workflow for testing a dev build end-to-end: stop the daemon with the trusted release binary first (`cc-review stop`, e.g. the brew install at /opt/homebrew/bin/cc-review), then run the dev binary — it spawns its own daemon it trusts (both sides are the same executable). The first command right after the stop can also fail with `wire: runtime receipt is unavailable` while the fresh daemon boots; retry a moment later. The daemon HTTP port persists across restarts (http.json in the state dir), so existing review URLs keep their port.
